surface_mechanism_description: The reactions with atmospheric carbon dioxide are due to the alkaline nature of lanthanide oxides, this behaviour being most pronounced for lighter lanthanides, especially for lanthanum. Carbonate-type impurity also partially explains the excess of oxygen and resulting deviation from the stoichiometric metal to oxygen ratios, which were observed in the TOF-ERD analyses.
